inputs.tag: QUESTIONABLE inherited/source values; PROJECTION calculations and transfers

upstream_pins.purpose: Read to recover the inherited thermal boundary equations; not run or imported.

atmosphere.column: Constant vapor mole fraction, solved from local RH; ideal-mixture hydrostatic profile.

account.joining: maximum(actual joining bill, 5% of faces plus core)

masks.gamma: baseline .2 for Vc<2, else 1; full .2+.4 min(Vc,2)

thermal.coupled: Air and sky shifted together; fixed optical coefficients, solar, wind and reference-density forced-convection formula.
thermal.numerics: 128 Gauss-Legendre zones; 241 core knots; degree 2..6 thermal curvature; inherited 1.002 guard.

night_constants.retention: All deposition retained, initially dry; no shedding, rain/fog impaction or evaporation of a preexisting film.

validation.limitation: Conservation, regression and convergence checks do not validate material transfers, weather distribution or installed-hull performance.

account_scope: 050 extends the original048 account and reproduces its R10 +124.262kg endpoint. It does not claim a rerun of the separately filed048 cure-included alternative. Thus no cure-inclusive R20/R30 weather ranking is inferred.
interpretation: Design-family boundaries allow different geometries. Fixed-hull boundaries retain one full-range build mass and stress screen. Marginal design-day percentiles are not annual flight probabilities; wet optics, drainage, installed water-control cost and physical cold/thermal validation remain open.
